about_the_game:
ARCFALL is a gripping adventure in which you awaken as a lone robot in a strange and hostile world — with no memory of how you got there. Your systems are damaged, and a critical malfunction is causing your energy to drain far too quickly. From that moment on, the clock is ticking in a desperate race against time.

Your goal is clear: survive long enough to recharge your energy, fix the malfunction, and uncover the truth about your situation. But the path ahead is perilous and filled with puzzles. Deep chasms, failing elevators, and tricky challenges that must be solved under pressure will stand in your way. Every second counts — with each step, your remaining energy dwindles, and the few recharge points you can find are rare and often difficult to reach.

As you fight your way through this mysterious world, you will uncover its secrets piece by piece. What happened here? Why have you awakened? And who — or what — is behind the fault that is slowly but surely bringing you to a halt?

ARCFALL challenges you to think fast, act with precision, and never lose sight of your goal — because once your energy runs out, it’s all over.

Features                                                                                                                                         

  • Constant time pressure

  • Challenging levels

  • Tricky puzzles

  • Atmospheric world

  • Varied obstacles
